mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bid (auction_id, bidder_id, amount, bid_time) VALUES (#{auctionId}, #{bidderId}, #{amount}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT bid.*, bidder.username AS bidder_username FROM bid JOIN user bidder ON bidder.id = bid.bidder_id WHERE bid.auction_id = #{auctionId} ORDER BY bid.amount DESC
SELECT bid.*, bidder.username AS bidder_username FROM bid JOIN user bidder ON bidder.id = bid.bidder_id WHERE bid.auction_id = #{auctionId} ORDER BY bid.amount DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE(b.bid_time) AS bidDate, COUNT(*) AS bidCount FROM bid b INNER JOIN auction a ON a.id = b.auction_id INNER JOIN ticket t ON t.id = a.ticket_id WHERE t.seller_id = #{sellerId} GROUP BY DATE(b.bid_time) ORDER BY bidDate ASC
